In the velvet sky, the moon doth glow,  
A silver lantern casting dreams below.  
Whispers of love in the cool night air,  
Each beam a promise, each shadow a dare.  
With a gentle smile, it lights up the sea,  
Reflecting the depths of you and me.  
Under its gaze, my heart starts to sway,  
As time drifts softly, like clouds in ballet.  
The night sings sweetly, a symphony rare,  
With you by my side, nothing else can compare.  
Forever entwined in this lunar embrace,  
In the world of the moon, we've found our place.
confidence_explanation: The poem captures the essence of romance and nature, centering on the moon as a symbol of love and connection.
